title: rosa pugetii var. genuina
intro: Rosa pugetii var. genuina, commonly known as Wild Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family (Rosaceae). It is a shrub-like plant with fragrant, pink flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits. The health benefits of Wild Rose include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote relaxation. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
